tool_schemas.name: get_teams
tool_schemas.description: Lists teams for the given league, optionally filtered by internal/external ids and team attributes, and returns up to `limit` results sorted by `sort`/`order`; when more results exist, use the returned `cursor` as the `cursor` parameter to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `league_code` is missing/invalid, any id fails its pattern, `limit` is out of range, `sort`/`order`/`status` are not in the allowed set, or `cursor` is malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to query the league, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded. If `log_request` is true, the request is recorded for monitoring; logging failures raise INTERNAL_ERROR.

league_code.description: League code to return teams for.

external_team_id.description: Filter by external provider team id.

limit.description: Maximum number of teams to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

log_request.description: Whether to record this request in api_request_logs.

tool_schemas.name: get_players
tool_schemas.description: Lists players for the given league, optionally filtered by internal/external ids, team, and player attributes, and returns up to `limit` results sorted by `sort`/`order`; when more results exist, use the returned `cursor` to page forward. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `league_code` is missing/invalid, any id fails its pattern, `limit` is out of range, `sort`/`order`/`status` are not in the allowed set, or `cursor` is malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to query the league, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded. If `log_request` is true, the request is recorded for monitoring; logging failures raise INTERNAL_ERROR.

league_code.description: League code to return players for.

external_player_id.description: Filter by external provider player id.

limit.description: Maximum number of players to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

log_request.description: Whether to record this request in api_request_logs.

tool_schemas.name: get_games
tool_schemas.description: Lists games for the given league with optional filters (season, team/home/away team, status, and start time range) and returns up to `limit` results sorted by `sort`/`order`; when more results exist, use the returned `cursor` to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `league_code` is missing/invalid, any team id fails its pattern, `limit` is out of range, `sort`/`order`/`status` are not in the allowed set, `start_time_from`/`start_time_to` are not valid RFC3339 timestamps, the time range is invalid (`from` > `to`), or `cursor` is malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to query the league, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded. If `log_request` is true, the request is recorded for monitoring; logging failures raise INTERNAL_ERROR.

league_code.description: League code to return games for.

team_id.description: Filter games where the given team is home or away.

start_time_from.description: Return games with start_time on/after this timestamp (inclusive).

start_time_to.description: Return games with start_time on/before this timestamp (inclusive).

limit.description: Maximum number of games to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

log_request.description: Whether to record this request in api_request_logs.

tool_schemas.name: get_game
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single game for the given league by `game_id` or `external_game_id` and returns the full game record when found. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `league_code` is missing/invalid, both identifiers are omitted, `game_id` fails its pattern, or inputs are otherwise malformed; raises NOT_FOUND if no game exists in that league for the provided identifier, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to query the league, and RATE_LIMITED if request quotas are exceeded. If `log_request` is true, the request is recorded for monitoring; logging failures raise INTERNAL_ERROR.

league_code.description: League code for the requested game.

external_game_id.description: External provider game id to fetch.

log_request.description: Whether to record this request in api_request_logs.

tool_schemas.name: get_leagues
tool_schemas.description: Lists leagues, optionally filtered by league attributes, and returns up to `limit` results sorted by `sort`/`order`; when more results exist, use the returned `cursor` as the `cursor` parameter to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `limit` is out of range or `sort`/`order`/`status` are not in the allowed set.

limit.description: Maximum number of leagues to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

log_request.description: Whether to record this request in api_request_logs.

tool_schemas.name: get_league
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single league by internal `league_id` (or by `code`) and returns the league record. Returns NOT_FOUND when no league matches and records http_status=404; otherwise records http_status=200. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if ids are malformed or both identifiers are omitted.

log_request.description: Whether to record this request in api_request_logs.

tool_schemas.name: get_team
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single team by internal `team_id` and returns the team record. Returns NOT_FOUND when no team exists for the id and records http_status=404; otherwise records http_status=200. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `team_id` fails its pattern or `league_code` is missing/invalid when provided.

league_code.description: Optional league code to assert the team belongs to; if provided and mismatched, returns NOT_FOUND.

log_request.description: Whether to record this request in api_request_logs.

tool_schemas.name: get_player
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single player by internal `player_id` and returns the player record. Returns NOT_FOUND when no player exists for the id and records http_status=404; otherwise records http_status=200. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if `player_id` fails its pattern or `league_code` is missing/invalid when provided.

league_code.description: Optional league code to assert the player belongs to; if provided and mismatched, returns NOT_FOUND.

log_request.description: Whether to record this request in api_request_logs.

tool_schemas.name: get_me
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity as inferred from the presented API key, including current scopes and rate-limit/quota status for operational monitoring. Returns UNAUTHENTICATED when no/invalid credential is provided, and may refuse with FORBIDDEN if the key is disabled.

api_key.description: Balldontlie API key used to authenticate the request.

log_request.description: Whether to record this request in api_request_logs.

metadata.name: Balldontlie Sports Data Server
metadata.description: This backend stores normalized sports reference data (leagues, teams, players) and event data (games) for NBA/MLB/NFL. The primary workflow is read-only querying of teams/players/games and fetching a single game by id; optionally the system tracks API access for operational monitoring and throttling
